question: Under ultraviolet light, the fur of a platypus glows a bluish green.
anchorText: It is also biofluorescent and glows cyan and green when under ultraviolet light

question: The 1917 Halifax Explosion — a munitions ship detonating in a harbour — was one of the largest man-made blasts before the nuclear age. Compared with it, roughly how powerful was the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima?
anchorText: the explosive power of the Little Boy bomb was seven times that of the Halifax Explosion
